To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effectiveness of tool interfacing is directly related to the level of the user's involvement and the degree of the environment's support.
the effectiveness of tool interfacing techniques depends on the type of tool integration, and the type of tool interfacing is determined by the type of user interface.

(1) the most productive integration technique for a specific tool is not necessarily the most productive technique for all tools, (2) the productivity of a tool can be improved by the integration of other tools, (3) the productivity of the integrated tool can be improved further if the integration is done by a more productive technique, and (4) a technique that is more productive for a tool is not necessarily more productive for other tools.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an effective software development environment, and the results of this research will provide useful guidelines to environment designers.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the user interface integration is the most effective in terms of improving user productivity, followed by the data integration, and finally by the control integration.
, for the purpose of improving user's productivity, the most effective integration technique is to provide the user with the ability of using the tools in a natural way.
the effectiveness of tool interface is dependent on the user's familiarity with the tools involved.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the integration techniques which have a higher degree of user control and a lower degree of tool control are more effective in improving the productivity than those which have the reverse degree of control.
, although the effectiveness of a particular technique depends on the nature of the tool, there is no single best technique for all cases.
the effectiveness of tool interface in terms of user's productivity is largely affected by the user's ability in understanding the integrated tools and their relationships.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effectiveness of tool interfacing can be improved by using the right combination of techniques.
the user interface integration technique, which provides a user-friendly interface for tool interaction, is the most effective technique in improving the user's efficiency.
the user's productivity can be improved through the use of tool integration techniques.
